metadata.course_name_from_curriculum: Scientific socialism_Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học
metadata.title: Scientific socialism - Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học
metadata.english_title: Scientific socialism - Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học
metadata.description:
Giới thiệu môn học: Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học là một trong ba bộ phận của chủ nghĩa Marx-Lenin. Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học đã dựa trên phương pháp luận triết học duy vật biện chứng và duy vật lịch sử, đồng thời cũng dựa trên những cơ sở lý luận khoa học về các quy luật kinh tế, quan hệ kinh tế để luận giải một cách khoa học về quá trình nảy sinh cách mạng xã hội chủ nghĩa, hình thành và phát triển hình thái kinh tế - xã hội cộng sản chủ nghĩa, gắn liền với sứ mệnh lịch sử của giai cấp công nhân, nhằm giải phóng con người, giải phóng xã hội.
Course introduction: Scientific socialism is one of the three parts of Marxism-Leninism. Scientific socialism is based on the philosophical methodology of dialectical materialism and historical materialism as well as scientific theoretical foundations of economic laws and economic relations to scientifically explain the advent of scientific socialism socialist revolution, the formation and development of the communist socio-economic form, associated with the historical mission of the working class, to liberate people and society.

Môn học Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học nhằm giúp cho sinh viên:
+ Về kiến thức: Sinh viên nắm được những tri thức cơ bản, cốt lõi nhất về Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học, một trong ba bộ phận cấu thành chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin.
+ Về kỹ năng: Sinh viên nâng cao được năng lực hiểu biết thực tiễn và khả năng vận dụng các tri thức Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học vào việc xem xét, đánh giá những vấn đề chính trị - xã hội của đất nước liên quan đến chủ nghĩa xã hội (CNXH) và con đường đi lên CNXH ở nước ta.
+ Về thái độ: Sinh viên có thái độ chính trị, tư tưởng đúng đắn về môn học Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học nói riêng và nền tảng tư tưởng của Đảng ta nói chung.
+ Hình thành tư duy phản biện, năng lực lý luận và ứng dụng thực tiễn các lý luận vào đời sống cá nhân và xã hội. Nhấn mạnh vai trò công dân và tinh thần trách nhiệm xã hội.
Knowledge: Students will acquire the fundamental and core knowledge of Scientific Socialism, one of the three components of Marxism–Leninism.
Skills: Students will enhance their capacity to understand practical realities and apply the knowledge of Scientific Socialism in analyzing and evaluating political and social issues of the country related to socialism (XHCN) and the path toward socialism in Vietnam.
Attitude: Students will develop a correct political attitude and ideology toward the subject of Scientific Socialism in particular, and the ideological foundation of the Communist Party in general. To develop critical thinking, reasoning competence, and the ability to apply theories to personal and social life. To emphasize civic roles and social responsibility.

Nội dung môn học bao gồm các chương: gồm 7 chương: chương 1, trình bày những vấn đề cơ bản có tính nhập môn của Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học (quá trình hình thành, phát triển của Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học); từ chương 2 đến chương 7 trình bày những nội dung cơ bản của Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học nhằm làm sáng tỏ những quy luật khách quan của quá trình cách mạng xã hội chủ nghĩa.
The course includes 7 chapters: Chapter 1: present basic introductory issues of Scientific socialism (the advent and development of Scientific socialism); Chapter 2 to chapter 7: present the basic knowledge of Scientific socialism to clarify the objective laws of the socialist revolution process.

Phương pháp dạy học: Thuyết giảng và kết hợp trình chiếu các slide bài giảng, ứng dụng AI hỗ trợ quá trình học. Hướng dẫn, giao bài tập đề tài theo nhóm. Tổ chức và hướng dẫn sinh viên thảo luận nhóm, thuyết trình và thực hiện sản phẩm sáng tạo.
Teaching methods: Lecturing combined with slide presentations, and applying AI to support the learning process. Providing instructions and assigning group projects. Organizing and guiding students in group discussions, presentations, and the creation of creative products.
metadata.student_tasks:
Sinh viên phải tham gia tối thiểu 80% thời gian môn học. Phải có giáo trình Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học, dành cho sinh viên bậc đại học hệ không chuyên lý luận chính trị của Bộ Giáo dục và Đào tạo. Chỉ sử dụng máy tính xách tay trong lớp cho mục đích học tập. Thực hiện đầy đủ các yêu cầu của giảng viên khi học trên lớp cũng như các chủ đề sinh viên tự chuẩn bị trước khi đến lớp. Ứng dụng AI một cách có trách nhiệm, đạo đức trong quá trình học và thực tiễn
Attend at least 80% of class hours. Own textbook on Scientific socialism for non-politics majored students as promulgated by the Ministry of Education and Training. Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose. Fulfill tasks given by the instructor in class as well as topics needed to prepare in advance. AI must be applied responsibly and ethically in both learning and practice.

learning_outcomes.details: Nắm vững những nội dung về sự ra đời, các giai đoạn phát triển, đối tượng, phương pháp và ý nghĩa của việc nghiên cứu chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học. Nắm vững được những tri thức cơ bản, cốt lõi nhất của Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học, một trong ba bộ phận cấu thành chủ nghĩa Mác - Lenin To master the contents regarding the emergence, stages of development, subject, methodology, and significance of studying Scientific Socialism. To firmly grasp the fundamental and core knowledge of Scientific Socialism, one of the three integral components of Marxism–Leninism.

Xây dựng kỹ năng lập luận, soạn thảo bài viết, thuyết trình, tư duy phản biện, xử lý các quan hệ xã hội và hoạt động nhóm. Xây dựng kỹ năng thích ứng, tự học, sử dụng AI có trách nhiệm, đạo đức phù hợp với quan điểm triết học, văn hóa - xã hội, lịch sử Việt Nam Develop skills of argument, writing, presentations, critical thinking, handling social relations and group activities. To build adaptability and self-learning skills, and to use AI responsibly and ethically in alignment with philosophical perspectives as well as Vietnam’s cultural, social, and historical context.
Nắm vững những nội dung của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin về sứ mệnh lịch sử của giai cấp công nhân Master Marxism-Leninism theory on the historical mission of the working class

Nắm vững những quan điểm của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin về chủ nghĩa xã hội, thời kỳ quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội bỏ qua chế độ tư bản chủ nghĩa ở Việt Nam và sự vận dụng sáng tạo của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam vào điều kiện cụ thể Việt Nam Master the Marxist-Leninist views on socialism, the transitional period towards socialism while ignoring the capitalist regime in Vietnam and the Communist Party of Vietnam's creative application to Vietnamese practices

Nắm vững những quan điểm của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin về nền dân chủ xã hội chủ nghĩa và nhà nước xã hội chủ nghĩa, quan điểm của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam về việc xây dựng và hoàn thiện nền dân chủ và nhà nước xã hội chủ nghĩa ở Việt Nam hiện nay Master the Marxist-Leninist views on socialist democracy and the socialist state, the Communist Party of Vietnam's view on building and perfecting socialist democracy and state in Vietnam today

Nắm vững cơ cấu xã hội - giai cấp và liên minh giai cấp, tầng lớp trong thời kỳ quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội Master social-class structure and alliances of class in the transitional period to socialism.

Nắm vững những quan điểm cơ bản của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin, đường lối, chính sách của Đảng và nhà nước Việt Nam về vấn đề dân tộc và tôn giáo Master fundamental viewpoints of Marxism-Leninism and the Vietnamese Party and State's lines and policies on ethnicity, religion issues

Nắm vững những quan điểm cơ bản của chủ nghĩa Mác – Lênin về vấn đề gia đình trong thời kỳ quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội Master fundamental viewpoints of Marxism-Leninism on family problems in the transitional period to socialism

Nâng cao năng lực hiểu biết thực tiễn và khả năng vận dụng các tri thức Chủ nghĩa xã hội khoa học vào việc xem xét, đánh giá các vấn đề chính trị xã hội liên quan đến con đường đi lên chủ nghĩa xã hội của đất nước. Có thái độ chính trị đúng đắn về môn học nói riêng và nền tảng tư tưởng của Đảng nói chung. To enhance practical understanding and the ability to apply the knowledge of Scientific Socialism in examining and evaluating socio-political issues related to the country’s path toward socialism. To develop a proper political attitude toward the subject in particular and toward the ideological foundation of the Party in general.

Hình thành năng lực lý luận và ứng dụng thực tiễn, nhấn mạnh vai trò công dân và tinh thần trách nhiệm xã hội. Hình thành thế giới quan, phương pháp luận thích ứng trước sự biến đổi nhanh chóng của thời đại, khoa học công nghệ. Hiểu được tầm quan trọng của giá trị nhân văn, xã hội trong tiến trình phát triển của nhân loại. To develop reasoning competence and practical application skills, with an emphasis on civic roles and social responsibility. To foster a worldview and methodology capable of adapting to the rapid transformations of the era and advances in science and technology. To understand the significance of humanistic and social values in the development of humankind.

metadata.title: History of CPV - Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam
metadata.english_title: History of CPV - Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam
metadata.description:
Giới thiệu môn học: Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam là một chuyên ngành, một bộ phận của khoa học lịch sử. Chủ tịch Hồ Chí Minh đã khẳng định Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam là cả một pho lịch sử bằng vàng. Đó chính là tính khoa học, cách mạng, giá trị thực tiễn sâu sắc trong Cương lĩnh, đường lối của Đảng; là sự lãnh đạo đúng đắn, đáp ứng kịp thời những yêu cầu, nhiệm vụ do lịch sử đặt ra; những kinh nghiệm, bài học có tính quy luật, lý luận của cách mạng Việt Nam và những truyền thống vẻ vang của Đảng.
Nghiên cứu, học tập lịch sử Đảng không chỉ nắm vững những sự kiện, cột mốc lịch sử mà cần thấu hiểu những vấn đề phong phú đó trong quá trình lãnh đạo và đấu tranh, để vận dụng, phát triển trong thời kỳ đổi mới toàn diện, đẩy mạnh công nghiệp hóa, hiện đại hóa đất nước và hội nhập quốc tế hiện nay.
Course introduction: History of CPV is a major and a division of historical science. President Ho Chi Minh affirmed that the history of the Communist Party of Vietnam is golden pages. That is scientific, revolutionary and profound practical value in the Party's platforms and guidelines, is proper leadership and timely response to requirements and missions set by the history; is the normative and theoretical experiences and lessons of Vietnamese revolution and the glorious traditions of the Party.
Researching and studying history of CPV not only requires mastering historical events and milestones but also understanding those issues in the process of leading and struggling; thereby applying and developing in the current period of comprehensive renovation and accelerating industrialization and modernization and international integration.

Mục tiêu môn học:
- Về nội dung: Cung cấp những tri thức có tính hệ thống, cơ bản về sự ra đời của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam (1920- 1930), sự lãnh đạo của Đảng đối với cách mạng Việt Nam trong thời kỳ đấu tranh giành chính quyền (1930- 1945), trong hai cuộc kháng chiến chống thực dân Pháp và đế quốc Mỹ xâm lược (1945- 1975), trong sự nghiệp xây dựng, bảo vệ Tổ quốc thời kỳ cả nước quá độ lên chủ nghĩa xã hội, tiến hành công cuộc đổi mới (1975- 2018).
- Về tư tưởng: Thông qua các sự kiện lịch sử và các kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo của Đảng để xây dựng ý thức tôn trọng sự thật khách quan, nâng cao lòng tự hào, niềm tin của sinh viên vào sự lãnh đạo của Đảng trong quá khứ và hiện tại.
- Về kỹ năng: Trang bị phương pháp tư duy khoa học về lịch sử, kỹ năng lựa chọn tài liệu nghiên cứu, học tập môn học và khả năng vận dụng nhận thức lịch sử vào công tác thực tiễn, phê phán quan niệm sai trái về lịch sử của Đảng.

Course Objectives:
- Knowledge: Students will understand basic and systematic knowledge of the establishment of the Communist Party of Vietnam (1920–1930); the Party’s leadership in the struggle for power (1930–1945); the Party’s leadership in the two wars against French colonialism and U.S. imperialism (1945–1975); and the Party’s leadership in the national transition to socialism and the Doi Moi reforms (1975–2018).
- Attitudes: Through historical events and experiences of the Party’s leadership, students will develop respect for objective truth, and deepen pride and confidence in the Party’s leadership in the past and present.
- Skills: Students will develop scientific thinking about history, skills in selecting research and study materials, and the ability to apply historical knowledge in practice, critically evaluate misconceptions about the Party’s history.

Nội dung môn học:
Môn học trang bị cho sinh viên những hiểu biết cơ bản về đối tượng, mục đích, nhiệm vụ, phương pháp nghiên cứu, học tập môn học Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam; những kiến thức cơ bản, cốt lõi, có hệ thống về sự ra đời của Đảng (1920 - 1930), về quá trình Đảng lãnh đạo cách mạng Việt Nam từ năm 1930 cho đến nay, từ đó, khẳng định các thành công, nêu lên các hạn chế, tổng kết những kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo trong thực tiễn cách mạng.
Ngoài Chương nhập môn, nội dung môn học được bố cục gồm 3 chương:
- Chương 1: Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam ra đời và lãnh đạo đấu tranh giành chính quyền (1930 - 1945);
- Chương II: Đảng lãnh đạo hai cuộc kháng chiến, hoàn thành giải phóng dân tộc, thống nhất đất nước (1945 - 1975);
- Chương III: Đảng lãnh đạo cả nước quá độ lên Chủ nghĩa xã hội và tiến hành công cuộc đổi mới (1975 - 2018).
Qua đó khẳng định các thành công, nêu lên các hạn chế, tổng kết những kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo cách mạng của Đảng để giúp người học nâng cao nhận thức, niềm tin đổi với Đảng và khả năng vận dụng kiến thức đã học vào thực tiễn công tác, góp phần xây dựng và bảo vệ Tổ quốc Việt Nam xã hội chủ nghĩa.

This course provides students with basic knowledge of objects, purposes, tasks, research and study methods of the History of CPV; the basic, core, systematic knowledge of the Party establishment (1920 - 1930), the process of the Party's leading the Vietnamese revolution from 1930 to the present, thereby, by affirming the successes, listing the limitations and summarizing experience of the Party’s leadership in revolutionary practices.
In addition to the introductory chapter, the course content includes three chapters:
- Chapter 1: The Communist Party of Vietnam was founded and led the rise to power (1930-1945);
- Chapter II: The Party led two resistance wars, completing national liberation and reunion (1945 - 1975);
- Chapter III: The Party led the national transition to socialism and carrying out the Doi moi (1975-2018).
Through this, students will recognize the achievements and identify the limitations of the Party’s revolutionary leadership, summarize the experiences gained, enhance their awareness and confidence in the Party, and develop the ability to apply the knowledge learned to practical work, contributing to the construction and defense of a socialist Vietnam.

Phương pháp dạy học: Thuyết giảng và kết hợp trình chiếu các slide bài giảng. Hướng dẫn, giao bài tập đề tài theo nhóm. Tổ chức và hướng dẫn sinh viên thảo luận nhóm, thuyết trình và thực hiện sản phẩm sáng tạo (tham khảo và ứng dụng phần mềm AI một cách có trách nhiệm).
Teaching method: Giving lectures and slide presentations. Guiding and assigning groupwork assignments. Organizing and guiding students in group discussions, presentations, and the development of creative products (with the responsible and ethical use of AI tools)

learning_outcomes.details: Hiểu được về đối tượng, mục đích, nhiệm vụ, phương pháp nghiên cứu, học tập môn học Lịch sử Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam Understand the objects, purposes, tasks, research and study methods of the History of CPV

Phân tích sự ra đời của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam (1920 - 1930), sự lãnh đạo của Đảng đối với cách mạng Việt Nam trong thời kỳ đấu tranh giành chính quyền (1930 - 1945), trong hai cuộc kháng chiến chống thực dân Pháp và đế quốc Mỹ xâm lược (1945 - 1975) Analyze the establishment of the Communist Party of Vietnam (1920 - 1930), the Party's leadership over the period of Rise to power (1930 - 1945) and two resistance wars against French colonialist and American imperialist invasions (1945 - 1975)

Nắm được quá trình xây dựng và bảo vệ Tổ quốc, quá độ lên Chủ nghĩa xã hội, tiến hành công cuộc đổi mới toàn diện đất nước (1975 - 2018) của Đảng Cộng sản Việt Nam. Từ đó, khẳng định các thành công, nêu lên các hạn chế, tổng kết những kinh nghiệm về sự lãnh đạo trong thực tiễn cách mạng Understand the national construction and defense, the transition to socialism, the implementation of the comprehensive renovation of the country (1975 - 2018) of the Communist Party of Vietnam. Thereby, affirming the successes, listing the limitations and summarizing experiences on leadership in revolutionary practices.

Củng cố và nâng cao niềm tin, niềm tự hào vào sự lãnh đạo của Đảng, định hướng phấn đấu theo mục tiêu, lý tưởng của Đảng Strengthen and enhance trust and pride in the Party’s leadership, and orient students to strive toward the Party’s goals and ideals.

Củng cố, nâng cao ý thức tự rèn luyện và tu dưỡng đạo đức cách mạng; thể hiện nhận thức chính trị, tư tưởng đúng đắn trong học tập và hoạt động thực tiễn Consolidate and strengthen students’ awareness of self-discipline and the cultivation of revolutionary ethics; and demonstrate sound political and ideological awareness in academic work and practical activities.
Nâng cao ý thức rõ hơn về trách nhiệm công dân trước những nhiệm vụ trọng đại của đất nước Raise higher sense of civic responsibility over important duties of the country

Xây dựng phương pháp tư duy khoa học về lịch sử; kỹ năng lựa chọn và tổng hợp tài liệu nghiên cứu, học tập; phát triển kỹ năng làm việc cá nhân và nhóm; ứng dụng công nghệ, đặc biệt là AI một cách có đạo đức và trách nhiệm để hỗ trợ nghiên cứu và học tập; đồng thời nâng cao kỹ năng thuyết trình và trình bày sản phẩm, kết quả nghiên cứu gắn với chủ trương của Đảng Develop scientific thinking methods in history; acquire skills in selecting and synthesizing research and learning materials; strengthen individual and group work skills; apply technology, especially AI, in an ethical and responsible manner to support research and learning; and enhance presentation skills in delivering research products and outcomes in line with the Party’s guidelines.

Vận dụng nhận thức lịch sử và thực tiễn để nhận diện, phân tích và chủ động phê phán quan niệm sai trái về lịch sử của Đảng Apply historical and practical knowledge to identify, analyze, and proactively criticize false perceptions of the Party’s history.

Vận dụng quan điểm của Đảng vào cuộc sống và công tác, biết kết hợp với những kiến thức chuyên ngành để chủ động, tích cực giải quyết những thực tiễn đặt ra theo đường lối, chính sách, pháp luật của Đảng và Nhà nước Apply the Party's viewpoints to life and work, combine it with specialized knowledge to proactively solve problems in reality in accordance with the guidelines, policies and laws of the Party and State

metadata.title: UI/UX Design _ Thiết kế trải nghiệm người dùng
metadata.description:
The UI/UX Design Specialization brings a design-centric approach to user interface and user experience design, and offers practical, skill-based instruction centered around a visual communications perspective, rather than on one focused on marketing or programming alone. In this sequence of four courses, students will summarize and demonstrate all stages of the UI/UX development process, from user research to defining a project’s strategy, scope, and information architecture, to developing sitemaps and wireframes. Students’ll learn current best practices and conventions in UX design and apply them to create effective and compelling screen-based experiences for websites or apps.

Final Exam is included of Final Theory Exam (TE) & Final Practical Exam (PE): 100%
Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.
Condition to pass: TE>=4 and PE>=4 and FR = (TE+PE)/2 + bonus >=5
metadata.student_tasks:
1. Student must get the certification of UI/UX Design Specialization specialization specialization from Coursera to be accepted to the final examination.
2. Complete the online course to be allowed to take Final Exam

learning_outcomes.details: Explain underlying concepts and principles related to UI/UX design
Apply the key formal elements of clear, consistent, and intuitive UI design to the to the design of a static screen-based interface
Apply current best practices and conventions in UX design and employ the fundamental principles of how UX design functions to shape an audience's experience of a given body of content
Define the strategy and scope of the site, as well as develope its information architecture and overall structure
Apply the UX research to actual user interfaces: the creation of wireframes, high-fidelity mockups, and clickable prototypes

metadata.description: This course is designed to develop knowledge, skills, and perspectives to support the application of managing products and developing brand strategies in the marketing area. It helps students to gain insights into the role of product and brand management in gaining and maintaining customer loyalty. Students are encouraged to make effective use of AI-powered tools to support their assignments. These technologies can assist in research, idea generation, content organization, and campaign planning, helping them focus more on strategic thinking and creativity in brand management.

assessments.no_question: Report + PresentationTask Description:Students will work in groups of 4 or 5 and immerse themselves in an extensive analysis of a specific brand as well as the company that owns it. As this is an extensive analysis, it will involve qualitative and quantitative research, and literature/market/industry review. Students are encouraged to select a brand for which public information is readily available. Brand managers, research managers and C-level executives are supposed to be the target audience for the brand audit report. Accordingly, the report should have multiple components including Brand History and Overview, Key Challenges Facing Brand, Brand Inventory, Brand Exploratory and maybe, Brand Resonance Pyramid. Presentation:For the 20-minute presentation, you are required to showcase all of your key points mentioned in your report in front of your classmates to help them gain insights into the brand you have chosen. Report: Include the following sections in your report1. Brand History and Overview Summarize the evolution of the brand, including its past and present positioning.2.Key Challenges Facing Brand Explain the key challenges facing the brand and lay the foundation for the brand audit focus and outcomes.3. Brand Inventory: Brief description/summary of each item 4. Brand Exploratory: Focus Group Insights 5. Reflections and Recommendations Generate marketing recommendations that address specific branding issues.6. Appendices Notes: Students are required to:1. Obtain formal approval from their lecturer for their selected topic before beginning the assignment.2. Use AI tools to research the industry and product category of their chosen brand by:• Synthesizing and aggregating industry information• Writing a brief summary of key findings• Demonstrating comprehensive understanding of the industry prior to topic consultation• Including a clear acknowledgment of AI tool usage in the report3. Note that while AI tools may be used to gain industry insights: • Students must acknowledge all AI-generated information in their reports.• Students must demonstrate their ability to conduct the brand audit independently.• The use of AI tools is required but will not be graded separately; the quality of their completed work will be assessed as a whole.Each student will need to conduct at least one interview/survey (choice of person interviewed to be approved by the instructor) and include the full transcript of the interview in the annex section of the report.An example of a completed brand audit appears in the textbook.
assessments.grading_guide: Test the acquainted knowledge which student obtained in the delivered chapters (1-10).
assessments.note:
Rubric: Brand Audit Group Assignment
1. Report (65%)
a. Brand History and Overview (10%)
Clear and concise summary of the brand’s evolution.
Demonstrates understanding of brand’s past/present positioning and relevance.
b. Key Challenges Facing the Brand (10%)
Identifies critical, evidence-based challenges.
Provides clear link to why these challenges matter for the audit.
c. Brand Inventory (10%)
Comprehensive and organized review of brand elements (logo, slogan, packaging, distribution, communications, etc.).
Balanced qualitative and quantitative details.
d. Brand Exploratory (15%)
Quality of primary research (e.g., focus group, survey, interviews).
Insightfulness of findings (e.g., customer perceptions, associations, experiences).
Integration of findings into the brand’s situation.
e. Reflections and Recommendations (10%)
Creative, realistic, and well-argued recommendations.
Directly address the brand challenges.
Show originality, feasibility, and alignment with brand positioning.
f. Literature / Market / Industry Review (5%)
Incorporation of credible secondary sources (academic + industry)
Shows evidence of both qualitative & quantitative research.
g. Organization, Formatting, Appendices (5%)
Professional structure (executive summary, headings, flow).
Appendices (focus group transcript, charts, tables) add value.
APA/Harvard citation style correct.
2. Presentation (25%)
a. Content & Key Insights (10%)
Covers all main sections of the report concisely.
Highlights major insights and challenges clearly.
b. Delivery & Engagement (5%)
Speakers are confident, organized, and balanced in group contribution.
Slides are professional, clear, and visually engaging.
c. Audience Relevance (5%)
Tailored for brand managers, executives, classmates.
Focused on decision-making insights rather than just description.
d. Time Management & Q&A (5%)
Stays within 20-minute limit.
Handles Q&A professionally and knowledgeably.
3. Effective usage of AI tools (10%)
Students will explain how they have utilized various AI-powered tools in their assignment.

assessments.no_question: Report + PresentationTask Description:Based on their Brand Audit, students will continue working with their teammates again to create one brand campaign in order to address brand’s challenges and embrace brand image. The brand campaign should follow brand voice guidelines and is able to highlight thoroughly the brand personality of the organization. For this assessment, students will practise with and apply the brand strategy model and methods to a real world brand of your choosing. Students will learn the difference between brand campaign strategies and other types of campaign strategies. Presentation:For the 20-minute presentation, you are required to showcase all of your key points mentioned in your report in front of your classmates.Your presentation should showcase how we are able to increase brand awareness and brand equity by using the right strategies, content and media platforms.Report:Students will apply all of the knowledge they have gained so far to create a simulated campaign again with the purpose of enhancing brand awareness and brand equity. The structure of the report will be revealed and modified during the class based on the brands the students choose to focus on.
assessments.grading_guide: Option1: Test the acquainted knowledge which student obtained in the delivered chapters (11-14).Option 2: (For Constructivism Approach only): Follow lecturer's proposal
assessments.note:
Rubric: Brand Campaign Plan Assignment (Option 1: Report + Presentation)
1. Report (65%)
a. Campaign Strategy & Alignment (15%)
Clear articulation of campaign objectives (awareness, equity, positioning).
Strong alignment between campaign goals and the brand’s challenges, image, and personality.
Distinguishes a brand campaign strategy from other campaign types.
b. Application of Brand Strategy Models (15%)
Effective use of models (e.g., Keller’s CBBE, Aaker’s brand identity model, resonance pyramid).
Shows how theory is translated into actionable strategy.
Demonstrates understanding of brand equity concepts.
c. Creativity & Brand Voice (10%)
Campaign reflects brand personality and adheres to brand voice guidelines.
Innovative ideas, engaging storytelling, and fresh approaches.
Realistic yet distinctive in positioning the brand.
d. Content & Media Plan (10%)
Clear articulation of proposed content types (visuals, messaging, storytelling).
Justification of chosen media platforms (digital, social, traditional).
Integration across platforms for consistency and reach.
e. Feasibility & Recommendations (10%)
Campaign plan is realistic given resources (time, budget, context).
Recommendations are actionable and defendable.
Risks and limitations considered.
f. Report Structure & Research Support (5%)
Logical, professional structure (executive summary, sections, flow).
Evidence from qualitative/quantitative data, industry sources, or case examples.
Correct referencing (APA/Harvard).
2. Presentation (30%)
a. Content & Insight Delivery (10%)
Highlights the key elements of the campaign strategy.
Shows how the campaign enhances brand awareness and equity.
Clear link to research and theory.
b. Creativity & Engagement (10%)
Presentation design is engaging, professional, and on-brand.
Delivery captures audience interest and communicates brand personality.
Strong group collaboration with balanced participation
c. Relevance & Audience Tailoring (5%)
Tailored for an executive-level audience (brand managers, C-suite).
Focuses on decision-making insights and practical outcomes.
d. Time Management & Q&A (5%)
Presentation flows well and stays within 20 minutes.
Q&A handled confidently, showing strong grasp of the material.
3. Effective usage of AI tools (5%)
Students will explain how they have utilized various AI-powered tools in their assignment.

metadata.title: Omnichannel Marketing_Bán hàng đa kênh
metadata.description:
Omnichannel marketing is a response to modern buying habits, providing consumers with a consistent brand experience whether traditional or digital. This course examines how marketers plan campaigns to reach consumers at every possible point of contact and how effective digital strategies can help businesses grow and thrive. This course also covers the critical topic of social customer service, customer experience and buyer's personas development. It provides also current and emerging issues of leadership and data protection and risk in digital time.
Students will use ChatGPT/Gemini for Inbound/Content Marketing strategies

After completing this course, students will be able to:
• Use best practices to create an omnichannel marketing strategy with a unified message, voice, and brand and a seamless customer experience
• Use best practices to develop researches on customer journey and buyer's personas
• Demonstrate an understanding of the key tactics and strategies associated with inbound channels including social media marketing, content marketing, search engine marketing, and email marketing
• Demonstrate an understanding of the key tactics and strategies associated with outbound channels including digital display, video, and YouTube advertising.

*Teaching method: This is a blended-learning course, in which students will take a look at the videos & slides and reading on Coursera first at home, then rewatch & discuss key questions with classmates and teachers at classes.

- Access the learning materials on Coursera for self-study purposes
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be eligible for the final assessment
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Access http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

metadata.description:
This Course is based on the both Coursera Specialization "The Strategy of Content Marketing" and "Social Media Management", which covers both the theorical and practical lessons of content marketing. You firstly will learn the core strategies content marketers use to acquire and retain customers profitably. Specifically, you will learn how to develop, organize and implement a content marketing strategy, analyze and measure the effectiveness of content marketing, write compelling copy, use a strategic framework when writing, and build your professional brand and authority through content marketing. You will also learn how to put the ideas presented to you into action and build your own personal brand through content marketing. You will end the course with real-world application of your skills through a content management project on social media.
This is a blended-learning course, in which students will take a look at the videos & slides and reading on Coursera first at home, then rewatch & discuss key questions with classmates and teachers at classes.
AI tools can significantly enhance content marketing efforts by automating tasks, improving content quality, and providing valuable insights. Some AI tools that can be used in content marketing include:
AI Writing Tools, AI Design Tools, AI Social Media Management Tools, AI Analytics Tools

assessments.note:
(Suggestion only) Students will find an example of a web-based content marketing effort for a company, product, service or non-profit organization to present to the class. The Core Message and Two Secondary Messages The Target Audience/Niche
Customer Benefits

The Publication Schedule

metadata.title: Google Ads and SEO - Google Ads và SEO
metadata.description: This course is designed to teach students to optimize website content for the best possible search engine ranking. Students will learn the theory behind Google search and other search engine algorithms, as well as build practical, real-world skills that can be applied to a career in digital marketing or online content development, including on-page and off-page optimization, optimizing for local and international audiences, conducting search-focused website audits, and aligning SEO with overall business strategies. Students will also learn how to create and execute search campaigns on Google Ads Search (formally AdWords). Through an introductory overview, students are guided through the official Google Ads Search training materials. Beyond Google materials, practical campaign creation and optimization best practices and exercises are provided to ensure the acquisition of practical skills and knowledge.

- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Access the course website (www.flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

metadata.title: Monetary Economics and Global Economy_Kinh tế tiền tệ và kinh tế toàn cầu
metadata.description: The course is an intermediate-level course in macroeconomics, including topics in international, monetary, and financial economics. The goal of the course is to provide a coherent framework for analyzing macroeconomic events, such as business cycles (recessions and booms) and long-run growth, their impact on financial markets, and to discuss macroeconomic policy. In all parts of the course, theories will be applied to current economic events. Particular emphasis will be placed on the relation between macroeconomic events and financial markets. Finishing this course, students will be well-versed in macroeconomic and finance areas, be able to realize the implications of real-life macroeconomic policy/ events on the global financial markets.

metadata.description:
The course provides a framework for interpretation, analysis and evaluation of financial statements from viewpoints of creditors, owners, investment firms and others. Thereby, the users of accounting information understand business strengths or weakness, the impact of general business and specific industry situations, behavior of financial markets, credit or lending criteria, and equity investment standards on present and future company financial conditions.
After completing the course, the student shall be able to:
- Be familiar with the organization and disclosure of reported information
- Quantitatively and qualitatively evaluate core accounting issues that are particularly relevant in the context of financial statement analysis.
- Have a framework for forecasting future earnings and financial performance.
- Evaluate the business financial performance by applying quantitative and qualitative techniques.
- Use financial statement information in a modeling environment to identify and recommend solutions to a variety of financial challenges, and to recommend investment decisions.

learning_outcomes.details: Apply established techniques, including appropriate technology for analyzing financial statement information for forecasting, valuation, and risk analysis purposes
Integrate and apply the major concepts and theories of fundamental analysis and key steps involved in conducting a fundamental analysis and valuation of a company
Evaluate the impact of financial reporting choices on the quality of accounting information including reported earnings; and assess the quality of accounting information in financial statements.
Use financial statement information in a modeling environment to identify and recommend solutions to a variety of financial challenges
Analyse and synthesise a firm’s financial statement information in the context of the firm’s economic and business condition to make informed recommendations on investment decisions about the firm
Show self-reliance when working independently and collaboratively
Demonstrate ethical awareness and reflection in business context

metadata.description: This module provides students with an understanding of the quantitative methods for finance and investment and assists their thesis writing. This includes the ability to formulate problems into quantitative models, to aid the successful resolution of the problem. Students will learn how to apply statistical methods to analyze past data and make forecast on future trends. Using output from mathematical and statistical models, students will learn to analyze, interpret and derive potential outcomes from financial information. Topics covered include financial data collection, probability, sampling, panel regression, time series analyses, and decision tree. Teaching method is flexible. Lecturers and tutors can mix between traditional teaching method with project-based learning, problem-based learning and flipped classroom.

learning_outcomes.details: Understand the econometrics methods necessary for doing empirical analysis in business, particularly in finance
Understand underlying assumptions of different econometrics models
Be able to identify the advantages and disadvantages of various methods and techniques and choose appropriate methods for specific datasets
Ulitize common statistical packages to conduct empirical research
Be able to conduct, interpret and critically deal with empirical studies in finance and related fields
Be able to work in a team or individually in making business decisions based on quantitative analysis; present one's self decisions.
Apply tools and knowledge to define, design and deliver an academically rigorous piece of research
Show awareness of statistical errors and understand of being ethical when conducting quantitative research

metadata.description: Introduction to International Business is designed to equip students with a comprehensive understanding of the fundamental principles and practices of conducting business in a globalized economy. It explores the dynamic interplay of socio-cultural, economic, technological, and political-legal factors that shape the international business environment. Students will gain insights into the strategies and techniques for entering and operating in foreign markets, including trade policies, global supply chains, and cross-border management. A key feature of this course is the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) tools and applications, enabling students to analyze international market trends, optimize decision-making processes, and develop innovative solutions to real-world business challenges. By the end of the course, students will be prepared to navigate the complexities of international business with a forward-thinking, technology-driven approach.

- Access the course website (www.flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.details: Recognize the key issues of globalization, and the national differences in political, economic, legal systems and culture
Apply AI to analyze global market trends and consumer sentiment, optimize solutions, and critically address bias, risks, and ethical responsibilities.

Demonstrate understanding about the ethical, corporate social responsibility, and sustainability faced by international business, and explaination how global managers can incorporate such issues into their decision making
Demonstrate understanding about the global trade and investment environment in which international business occurs
Describe characteristics of the foreign exchange market, different theories relating to exchange rate and how to manage foreign exchange risks
Identify the different global strategies and entry modes that firms use to compete in the global marketplace

Explain how firms can perform their key functions including global production, global supply chain management, global marketing, global research and development to compete and succeed in the international business environment
Evaluate external environment of a specific foreign market
Propose the suitable entry mode for a specific company to enter foreign market.
Demonstrate attitude to adapt to differences and complex issues in doing international business

metadata.title: Cross Cultural Management and Negotiation_Quản trị và đàm phán trong môi trường đa văn hóa
metadata.description:
This course explores the effect of cultural differences on organisational behaviour and negotiation in the global context. It exposes students to issues and problems that inevitably arise in international business when managers have to deal with culturally determined differences in values, attitudes and behaviours.
The course assists students in developing cross-cultural communication competence and management and negotiation skills to successfully solve problems and capitalise on opportunities in a multicultural environment.

-Use laptop in class only for learning purpose

materials.description: International Management: Culture, Strategy, and Behavior
materials.author: Fred Luthans and Jonathan Doh
Roy J. Lewicki, Bruce Barry, and David M. Saunders
Roy J. Lewicki, Bruce Barry, David M. Saunders
materials.note: Chọn một trong 2 quyển Negociation. Ưu tiên mua ấn bản mới nhất

learning_outcomes.details: Describe cultural dimensions based on cultural frameworks and apply them to global business settings.
Identify different negotiation scenarios, then formulate and apply the instruments of negotiation strategy and tactics.
Develop cultural intelligence to interact and manage people from different cultures.
Developing capability to competently apply course concepts in cross- cultural situations that require responses at the individual, managerial and organisational levels.

Identify the major dimensions of culture relevant to work settings and discuss their effect on behavior in an international environment. Describe negotiation styles in different cultures; adjust negotiation tactics to cultural differences.
Explain the motivation, leadership and HR selection across cultures.
Develop cultural sensitivity needed to succeed in any kind of cross-cultural interactions.
Differentiate the different types of negotiation approaches (integrative, distributive negotiations).
Describe the strategies and actions taken on different stages of negotiations; appreciate and explain the importance of pre-; during and post-negotiation phases.
List the roles and functions in negotiation teams; demonstrate the skills of organizing and managing negotiation teams.

metadata.title: Supply Chain Management_Quản lý chuỗi cung ứng
metadata.description:
A supply chain is comprised of all the parties involved in fulfilling a customer request. The integrated management of this network is a critical determinant of success in today’s competitive environment.
Supply chain management is the systemic, strategic coordination of the traditional business functions within a particular company and across businesses within a supply chain, for the purpose of improving the long-term performance of the individual companies and the supply chain as a whole. The major supply chain processes include planning, sourcing, making or converting, fulfillment, and relationships management. The major dimensions for evaluating the performance of supply chain processes and activities are time, cost, quality and compliance. This course covers the major activities of companies involved in profitably coordinating supply and demand in the marketplace to deliver consumer value.

metadata.title: International Economics_Kinh tế quốc tế
metadata.description: This course will study the economic relations among nations through analyzing the exchange of goods, services as well as the linkages between trade, labor and capital movements, international fragmentation of production, economic well-being and the income distribution and to identify and critically examine policy implications of these linkages. Besides that, the course provides students both classical and modern theories of international trade in goods and services, as well as empirical research on trade . A substantial fraction of the course is dedicated to examination of efficient trade policies. This course also covers the balance of payments, exchange rates and open-economy macroeconomics.
metadata.student_tasks:
- Class attendance is strongly encouraged. Attend at least 80% of class hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Read the textbook in advance
- Access the course website (http://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course, for online supports from teachers and other students and for practicing and assessment.

learning_outcomes.details: Recognize the overview of world trade, cause of trade, the pattern of word trade, the way of word trade has evolved over time
Demonstrate the global capital market: performance and policy problems
Identify the idea of optimum currency areas
Demonstrate the understanding of Growth, Crises and International Speculation
Identify the the main Traditional Models of International Trade
Understand the Imperfect Competition and New Theories of International Trade

State the linkages between trade, labor and capital movements, international fragmentation of production, economic well-being and the income distribution and to identify and critically examine policy implications of these linkages
Identify International factor mobility
Analyze instruments and consequences of trade policy measures

Discuss the political economy of Trade Policy: the motivation for protectionist policies, examples of current trade agreements, Recent controversies in trade policy and trade retaliation, Trade policy in developing countries, links between trade and the environment.
Understand the exchange Rates, Price Levels and Money
Analyze clearly the intertemporal approach to current account, balance of payments and the trade balance;

metadata.course_name_from_curriculum: International Payment_Thanh toán quốc tế
metadata.combo_name_from_curriculum: MKT_COM4: International Business_Kinh doanh quốc tế
metadata.title: International Payment_Thanh toán quốc tế
metadata.description:
This course is designed to provide students with a deep understanding of international payment including: parties to the international payment transaction; four primary payment methods: documentary letters of credit, documentary collections, pre-payment and credit transactions with detail description of documentary letters of credit (both standard and special letters of credit) and documentary collections; payment currency; ... It also covers: foreign exchange (forward contracts); documents used in trade; Letter of credit application and instructions; trade terms (Incoterms 2020); Cyber transaction on the Internet.
Topics mainly include: (1) Key Issues in International Payments. (2) Buyer and the Seller. (3) Basic Terms of Payment (4) Foreign Exchange (5) Various trade terms (Incoterms 2010). (6) Drafts and Acceptances. (7) Documentary Collections. (8) Documentary Credits. (9) Document and Document Checklists. (10) Cyberpayments.
AI Tools will be used to support students in
(1) generating ideas/structures for their speaking notes and slide structure of 4 important topics of the course: Incoterms, International contract, Documentary Collection, and Documentary Credits; and for their group presentation topic.
(2) editing the slide set after students have already finished it.
metadata.student_tasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Read the textbook in advance

materials.description: A Short Course in International Payments
materials.author: Edward G. Hinkelman

learning_outcomes.details: Understand the key concepts of international trade and international payment
Introduce the parties to a documentary collection, describe process and analyze advantages and disadvantages of documentary collection
Utilize URC 522 to a documentary collection
Categorize three types of collections
Perceive the important principles regarding the role of banks
Discuss about notes, tips, and cautions for sellers, buyers and banks
Classify types of credits basic
Utilize UCP600 to a documentary credits
Understand regarding the role of banks in documentary credits and settlement by payment
Understand and distinguish the standard credits
Understand and distinguish the special letters of credit
Distinguish international payment with domestic payment
Discuss about notes, tips, and cautions for sellers, buyers and banks in documentary credits
Understand and construct documents (commercial invoice, bill of lading, insurance document, certificate of origin, packing list, inspection certificate...)
Apply document checklists
Define cyberpayments, electronic commerce, secure electronic transaction standards.
Understand the business concerns of the buyer and seller and how these concerns affect decisions relating to which payment method is used in an international transaction.
Identify the key factors in determining the payment method
Distinguish international payment methods
Understand and analyze the currency in international payment and foreign exchange risk.
Identify the drafting of a contract, performance or modification of contractual obligations, resolution of disputes, and enforcement of judgments or orders.
Distinguish the before finalize a contract.
Understand the formal definition of draft, acceptances, holding or discounting acceptances.

metadata.combo_name_from_curriculum: MKT_COM4: International Business_Kinh doanh quốc tế
metadata.title: International Marketing_Marketing quốc tế
metadata.prerequisites: MKT101 or MKG101 or MMK101 or IBI101
metadata.description: This Specialization covers marketing concepts but, more importantly, emphasizes the need by companies and individuals to think openly across international markets and industries for new ideas or expansion. This is summarized as "Cross Country & Cross Industry" Innovation, or CCCI in short. The first two courses will establish the core foundations and then the last three courses will elaborate on major global industry clusters: course 3 on B2B, course 4 on Healthcare and Hospitality, and course 5 on Sports and Entertainment. The capstone will require learners to develop a new product using knowledge learned from at least 2 industries.

learning_outcomes.details: Understand the basic foundations of international marketing and be able to explain how companies can grow by going abroad or sourcing ideas/expanding into other countries or industries.

Understand consumer science investigation, B2C marketing, International Marketing Entry, Targeting, Positioning, International Product, International Promotion, International Place and International Price
Understand the differentiating aspects of business to business (B2B) marketing that can be contrasted to traditional business to consumer (B2C) marketing
Understand the unique characteristics of both hospitality and healthcare services sector.
Understand the characteristics and marketing strategies related to two key global industries, sports and entertainment.
Be able to apply what you have learned during the 16 weeks of the 5 courses

metadata.description:
-Objective: To provide a basic understanding of the hospitality and tourism industry by tracing the industry's growth, development, issues facing, and future trends
-Description: The course addresses the tourism and hospitality industry's structure, scope, and measurement. The students will be exposed to the roles of industry business players and governments. This course addresses the knowledge and skill needed for students to understand the development of the hospitality and tourism industry and its challenges.

metadata.description:
- Main objective: This course provides an overview of the operations of a mid-size full-service hotel, from lodging to food and beverage, marketing and sales, human resources,... The focus of this course will be on explaining the functions of each department in a hotel, the inter-relationships among them, and management skills development. This course offers up-to-date information of multiple aspects in hotel operations, and essential insights for future hotel managers.
-Description: Hotel operational management introduces an overview of thel operation and organization of a midsize hotel. The course focuses on the front office, housekeeping, F&B and how they relate to each other in order to provide excellent service to customers. Other departments are also explained to provide a full understanding of the organization of a hotel. Students are to practice their analyzing and problem solving skills with up-to-date real life example and current trends.
-Teaching method: lecture, discussion, demonstration, roleplay, project based learning, group work

This course has been designed to achieve the following objectives:
To study the skills and science of food and beverage management. The systems approach to food and beverage (F&B) management is presented and includes planning and control of F&B operations. Management operation systems are also presented and integrated with F&B delivery systems for a complete F&B overview.
Description: Managing food and beverage is essential for the hospitality industry. This course addresses
the key concepts of the food and beverage industry and the management aspects of the
trade

metadata.description:
In order to remain competitive, hospitality organizations of today, in particularly highend hotels are very much focused on the “guest experience”. They are under high
pressure to deliver high service standards as today’s consumers are looking for more
value for their money. This course covers the topic of managing hospitality organizations by using academic studies and real life experiences from companies and is written in three sections: Strategy, Staffing and Systems. Each chapter includes at suggested hospitality activities for students, in which students are encourages to visit local organizations to talk with guests, employees and managers to obtain a variety of perspectives on the guest experience.

metadata.combo_name_from_curriculum: MKT_COM5: Hotel Management_Quản trị khách sạn
metadata.title: Hotel Revenue Management_Quản trị doanh thu khách sạn
metadata.description:
This Specialization covers the basics of hotel demand management, distribution, and revenue management. You’ll learn how e-commerce intermediaries such as online travel agencies are impacting the already-complex hospitality sector, and you’ll explore tools and techniques that will help you effectively market hospitality services and maximize business revenue in this new global industry landscape. In the final Capstone Project, you’ll evaluate the importance of hotel branding in business success through a hands-on, real-world case study. During the sessions, you will hear from senior hotel industry executives commenting on distribution, revenue and demand management issues. We will also interview two leading Online Travel Agents on how to maximise online business for your property, and have partnered with Duetto and SnapShot, two leading hospitality industry companies, to gain access to cutting edge knowledge, thus insuring that the competencies that you gain will make you operational immediately as well as bang up to date on industry trends.
Note: Students who complete all MOOCs before the course deadline will receive 1 bonus point; otherwise, no bonus point will be awarded.
metadata.student_tasks: Access the specialization on Coursera and complete all courses' requirements to earn a certificate of completion for the specialization, in order to be qualified for the Final Exam.

learning_outcomes.details: Understand how to manage an increasingly complex network of traditional and web based channels of hotel sector.
Provide a core understanding of the fundamentals of revenue management, which ties into the larger picture of revenue strategy.
Understand the journey from long-term asset development through to short-term profit tactics and how commercial teams can align themselves throughout the organisation.
Understand how to apply the knowledge you have gained about distribution, revenue and demand management to a ‘real’ world case.

metadata.title: Crisis Communications Management_Quản trị truyền thông khủng hoảng
metadata.prerequisites: CCO201 or MKT304 or IMC301c or IMC301
metadata.description:
This course covers crisis communication theory, crisis management approaches, classic cases and the influence of culture on crisis communication. This course will introduce the definitions of crisis and how they come about, the importance of the Enterprise Risk Management framework in crisis prevention and preparation, and how we can recognise and address crises in case they happen. This course focuses on the role of communications throughout the crisis management process, as well as how to utilise media relations and social media to prevent and/or respond to crises.
Apart from learning academic theories, students will have opportunities to apply their acquired knowledge & skills in analysing a real-world case study, as well as developing a industry-facing crisis communication plan for an organisation ("client") and self-organising an accompanied simulated media conference to address a crisis of that organisation. Throughout that, students will be equipped with practical experience and skills to be ready for their future career path in the communications field.
Finally, students can also use AI to assist their practices and assignemnts.
metadata.student_tasks:
- Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class
- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Read the textbook in advance
- Access the course websites (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn) for up-to-date information and material of the course.

learning_outcomes.details: Identify organisational, industrial and environmental challenges and disasters
Demonstrate an understanding of the concepts, theories and practice of issues management and crisis communication.
Utilize AI to analyse and develop strategies for organisational issues using the theories, models and methods of issues management and crisis communication
Gain the capacity to critique organisational and industrial responses to issues and crises in terms of attitude and ethics
Develop a critical attitude towards crisis communications management
Identify and apply ethical standards of practice when dealing with issues management and crisis communication
Skills in analysis and problem solving; AI Literacy and Responsible Communication; Proficient in presentation and teamwork skills; positive contributing attitude in the class and groupworks

assessments.note:
Individual Assessment (At home)
Type: Essay
Weight: 15%
Length: 1,500-2,000 words
Task Description:
Choose from the list of crisis case studies provided by the lecturer before and analyse one organisational crisis.
Your essay will include an overview of the crisis, a description of the organisation, a crisis timeline, actions and responses taken, a media analysis, stakeholder impacts, lessons learned, recommendations, and use appropriate matrix/models.
The essay should address the criteria as outlined in the assessment task and rubric mentioned during the class.
Students should use a mix of scholarly references, media coverage and organisational materials, as well as applying AI-tools to collect information and analyze the chosen crisis.

Students working within a small group setting of 4-6 students to select one organisation in Vietnam, which must be accepted by the lecturer, then propose a crisis communication plan for that organisation. The plan must showcase all knowledge the students have gained in the class, and be delivered as a final report to their chosen organisation.

Presentation: For the 15-minute presentation, each group have to showcase all of your key points mentioned in your report in front of your classmates.

Notes:
The detailed structure of a crisis communication plan could be found in the textbook (Chapter 5)
Further details of the crisis communication plan will be provided in class. The detailed marking criteria for this assessment will be provided to you by your lecturer.

metadata.description:
This course provides a comprehensive introduction to corporate communications and public relations: it is for anyone with an interest in corporate communication, or anyone seeking to understand the growing importance of communication for corporations. Corporations increasingly need communication to survive, as they need to entertain relations with a variety of stakeholders to prosper. This includes not only external factors to the organization – customers, governments and civil ociety organizations, but also stakeholders within corporations themselves, such as employees, managers and investors.

The first weeks of the course focus on the basics of corporate communication: what is it, and what are its historical roots? This is important, as it demonstrates how the position of communication is increasingly considered to be managerial function – and as such should be involved in the key decision-making processes. After these introductory weeks, we turn to two core theories of corporate communication: stakeholder theory and corporate identity. These form the basis for much of the more specific and applied topics covered in the following weeks.

In addition, students will be introduced to the use of AI in corporate communications. This includes how to leverage AI tools for stakeholder analysis, media monitoring, content creation, and campaign evaluation, as well as how to address ethical and cultural considerations when adopting AI. In the last two weeks before the midterm exam, we discuss how corporations can construct communication campaigns – which will be useful as you will be tasked with creating your own communication campaign during the course. Students will also explore how AI can support the design and execution of such campaigns through audience segmentation, trend analysis, and strategic messaging assistance. After the midterm exam, we tackle specific topics of corporate communication, such as employee communications, how corporations interact with media and journalists, and how corporations should communicate in times of crisis.

Comprehend the skills needed to develop impactful corporate communication strategies and/or convey them persuasively.
Develop and/or implement effective corporate communication plans.
Adopt a constructivist approach to learning that enhances creativity, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, while leveraging AI for brainstorming and innovative solutions.

assessments.grading_guide:
Case Study Analysis
Students will analyze a real-world corporate communication case (e.g., crisis response, CSR campaign, leadership communication, reputation management).
Task:
- Identify the key communication challenge(s).
- Apply corporate communication theories and frameworks to analyze the case.
- Use AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Google Gemini) for supporting tasks such as sentiment analysis, social listening, reputation evalution.
- Critically evaluate the effectiveness of the adopted strategy.
- Propose alternative or improved solutions with clear justification.

Option 2 (for the constructivism approach only): Follow the lecturer's proposal.

assessments.duration:
Presentation: 20 mins per each group
Q&A: 20 mins per each group
assessments.no_question: Analyse the lastes communication challenge of a corporate and strategically develop a communication management and measurement plan to response to it.
assessments.grading_guide: Possess the ability to: (1) critically identify and analyze a communication challenge; (2) strategically apply relevant concepts and/or theories to develop a CMM plan in response to the situation; 3) Use AI tools for supporting tasks such as stakeholder mapping, competitor scanning, strategic message drafting.
assessments.note:
In class and homework. Written report (50%) & Oral presentation (50%)
CMM Plan Requirements
- Executive Summary – overview of communication challenge, objectives, and AI integration highlights.
- Situation Analysis – SWOT/PESTLE, media/stakeholder audit, AI-assisted sentiment or competitor analysis (validated by human review).
- Stakeholder Mapping & Target Audiences – AI-assisted clustering (e.g., Brandwatch, Talkwalker, ChatGPT) + team refinement.
- Communication Goal & SMART Objectives – aligned with corporate strategy.
- Key Messages – ensure message consistency, multicultural sensitivity, and ethical considerations.
- Strategies & Tactics (may covering multiple corporate communication domains):
- Integration & Channel Strategy – how AI supports consistent messaging across touchpoints.
- Budget & Resource Allocation – realistic planning, noting AI efficiency gains.
- Evaluation Plan – success indicators (trust, reputation, engagement, stakeholder sentiment), supported by AI dashboards.

Deliverables
- CMM Report (max 20 pages): Situation analysis, objectives, stakeholder mapping, strategies & tactics, integration and evaluation framework.
- Presentation Deck: 20 minutes presentation + 20 minutes Q&A.
- Reflection Section (300–500 words per group): How AI was applied, its benefits, limitations, risks, and ethical considerations.

metadata.description: This specialization explores three key genres of creative writing: short story, narrative essay, and memoir. You will learn the techniques used by skilled writers to craft compelling stories with memorable characters, engaging settings, and fresh descriptive styles. You will also analyze and provide constructive feedback on peer writing. In the Capstone project, you will draft, revise, and complete an original story in the genre of your choice. Through four courses, each focusing on a specific aspect of writing and taken in any order, you will enhance your writing skills, refine your ability to critique others' work, and draw inspiration from the literature you already enjoy reading.

assessments.note:
For the final exam, students answer two questions: one theoretical question and one practical question.
For the practical question, students are asked to apply all skills they have learned in the course to create a story of minimum 400 words, either fiction or nonfiction. The topic of the story is given by the exam board. The exam topics will revolve around the areas previously covered.
The story should involve a plot, character, setting and description and show their style. The writing must include the following elements:
1. A clear plot structure: with beginning, development, climax, and resolution.
2. Well-developed, consistent, and memorable characters.
3. A vividly described setting in terms of time and space, rich in sensory detail.
4. Use of creative language that reflects a personal and distinctive writing style.

metadata.description:
This practicum course is designed to give students the opportunity to apply theoretical knowledge learned before to actual multimedia production situations. This course incorporates in its approach a combination of applied media aesthetics theory and hands-on production experience in video production. Students will gain a foundation for understanding media production theory, facilitating video production processes as well as creating and evaluating media products relating to a particular issue set by the course lecturer. A component of the course will permit the introduction of current topics such as media issues, professional video production techniques, changing media technology, and job market information. In addition, the course will also introduce some applications of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the video production process, allowing students to explore and utilize these advanced technologies to enhance the efficiency and quality of their media products.
As a student of the class, you will sample a variety of production work through active team participation. Based on the quality of the video, your product might be published on FPT’s media platforms.

learning_outcomes.details: Explain fundamental video production principles and techniques by describing the stages of production (pre-production, production, and post-production) and the functions of key roles within a production crew.

Analyze the impact of scriptwriting, visual elements, and audio elements on storytelling by identifying key techniques in scripting, camera work, lighting, sound, and editing that enhance narrative flow and audience engagement.
Apply technical skills in operating video production equipment, including cameras, lighting systems, and audio devices, to capture high-quality footage.
Edit video and audio content proficiently using industry-standard software, focusing on continuity, pacing, transitions, and the integration of visual and sound effects to strengthen storytelling.
Use AI tools to enhance production efficiency and optimize workflow in tasks such as content planning, editing support, asset generation, and post-production enhancement.
Demonstrate effective teamwork and communication skills by collaborating within a production team, coordinating tasks, sharing responsibilities, and managing conflicts professionally.
Exhibit professional responsibility and ethical standards in video production by respecting copyright, privacy, and cultural sensitivity throughout all stages of content creation and distribution.

metadata.title: Brand Identity Design_Thiết kế nhận diện thương hiệu
metadata.description:
Description: 'The aim of this course is to equip students with the basic knowledge of Brand Identity Design: Brand basics (what is brand, brand identity, branding; brand strategy...), Brand ideals (flexibility,value, differentiation, sustainability…), Brand elements (brandmarks, wordmarks, symbol, characters…), Brand dynamics (Social media, Mobile, …; Private labeling, Brand licensing, Certification…); Brand identity design (Logotype + signature, Color, Typography, Trial applications, Presentation…), Brand book (Standards + guidelines..), (Managing, Measuring, Decision making, Intellectual property, Design management...)
Objectives:
'- The Branding & Identity Design course will prepare students to design and establish visual identities and brand standards across a variety of mediums. The course will help the student look beyond logo design and acquire a fundamental understanding of the aspects of designing a brand system that is scalable and replicable, regardless of application
'- Throughout this course, emphasis will be placed on the use of logo, including its use as a valuable analytical tool for the visual communication professions.
Teaching method:
Under lecturer’s instruction, through a series of instruction sessions, researchanalysis and personal exercises, students will be equipped with knowledge and skills to develop and complete a brand identity system
metadata.student_tasks:
- Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination
- Actively participate in class activities
- Fulfil tasks given by intructor after class
- Use personal laptop in class only for learning purpose
- Read the textbook in advance
- Access the course website https://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date information and material of the course
- Wacom or digital drawing tools is suggested but not required

- Internet connection.
